brand.name: myPaisaa
brand.positioning: Smart Monthly Savings & Instant Low-Cost Funds (₹1L to ₹30L) with Govt. of Telangana (T-Chits) Security Deposit Compliance
brand.target_audience: Salaried professionals, business owners, and savvy savers across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh & Karnataka seeking legal, high-dividend savings or low-friction capital.
brand.tone: Warm Indian fintech credibility, transparent, empowering, and conversational (WhatsApp first).

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY + VIBRANT HIGH-CONVERSION FINTECH (myPaisaa Brand Green & Gold)

surfaces.name: mobile_sticky_bar
surfaces.guarantee: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0C2317]/95 border-t border-emerald-500/20 shadow-2xl px-4 py-3

typography.hierarchy_rules: Hero heading clamped at max 56px desktop (36px mobile). Never exceed text-6xl. Labels uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-xs font-semibold.

entry_surfaces./: split hero with brand value proposition, dual WhatsApp/App CTAs and live compliance badge on left; interactive Quick Chit Calculator and verified member metrics card on right

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_rules: Asymmetric multi-column grids for trust and how-it-works sections (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with 8/4 or 7/5 splits).
spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Designed strictly mobile-first with thumb-zone CTAs, fluid sliders, tap-friendly WhatsApp links, and persistent bottom sticky action strip.

components_and_sections.description: Sticky glass navbar with myPaisaa mascot/logo, live regulatory trust badge ('100% Regulated by Govt. of Telangana (T-Chits)'), plan quick-links, calculator jump, and 'Chat on WhatsApp' action button with pulse dot.

High-impact conversion hero: rewritten crisp headline ('Save Smart. Borrow Smarter. 100% Regulated Chit Funds from ₹1 Lakh to ₹30 Lakhs'), dual primary CTA (WhatsApp fast-track + Google Play / App Store download badges), and trust strip featuring ₹500Cr+ Disbursed, 50,000+ Verified Members, 100% Security Deposit Pledged with Govt Registrar, and 24-hr Auction Payouts.

Visual non-boring credibility matrix: Chit Funds Act 1982 seal, T-Chits Govt Portal verification badge with live check link, 100% FD security deposit pledged in scheduled banks, Razorpay & UPI payment security, and DPIIT / Bharat Inclusion Initiative backing.

Interactive Chit Calculator & Plan Explorer: Slider or toggle covering the 7 official myPaisaa plans (₹1L, ₹2L, ₹3L, ₹5L, ₹10L, ₹15L, ₹30L). Shows monthly installment, duration (25 months), estimated dividend savings (up to 8-10% IRR), maximum early auction winning pool, and direct 'Lock Plan on WhatsApp' trigger.

Quick 4-step interactive flow (Income Type, Monthly Income bracket, State: Telangana/Andhra/Karnataka/Other, Document availability). Instantly gives tailored qualification verdict and generates pre-filled WhatsApp message link with user parameters.

4 scannable modern steps with clean illustrations: 1. 2-Min eKYC & Group Joining -> 2. Save Monthly with UPI auto-debit -> 3. Bid in Weekly In-App e-Auctions -> 4. Win & Receive Payout in 24 Hours or Earn Dividends as Passive Saver.
7 Scannable Tier Cards categorized for 'Young Savers' (₹1L, ₹2L), 'Growth & Emergencies' (₹3L, ₹5L), and 'Business & Wealth' (₹10L, ₹25L, ₹30L) with one-click direct WhatsApp enquiry.
Real customer stories from Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Vijayawada: salaried IT managers saving for down payments, MSME business owners funding emergency inventory, and disciplined household savers.

Transparent, plain-spoken answers addressing user skepticism: 'Is chit fund safe & legal?', 'How is my money protected?', 'What if someone defaults?', 'How are dividends calculated?', 'When can I withdraw?'
Bold contrast banner with QR code for desktop + direct app store links, 4.7-star rating display, and 100k+ downloads badge.
Fixed bottom thumb bar on mobile with high-contrast WhatsApp button ('Chat with Chit Advisor') and Quick Calculate / Download toggle.

Comprehensive footer with statutory disclosures (Registered Chit Fund Company details, Chit Funds Act 1982, Telangana Registrar compliance), company address in Hyderabad, grievance officer contact, and disclaimers.

motion_and_interactions.principles: Subtle, purposeful motion that builds trust. Spring physics for interactive sliders and tab switches. Pulse animations on live auction indicators and WhatsApp action triggers.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards elevate with -translate-y-1 and crisp green border glow (border-emerald-500/30). Buttons have active:scale-95 and clear high-contrast states.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion using conditional CSS / Framer Motion settings.

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (4.5:1 text contrast on all surfaces).
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='hero-whatsapp-btn', data-testid='chit-slider', data-testid='plan-card-3lakh-enquire', data-testid='eligibility-next-btn').
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons, sliders, and modal triggers have explicit aria-label and aria-expanded attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace frontend/src/index.css with Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans variable font imports and standard brand palette variables.

2. Build modular frontend components in frontend/src/components/ (Navbar, Hero, TrustCompliance, ChitCalculator, EligibilityModal, HowItWorks, PlansCatalog, Testimonials, FAQ, StickyMobileBar, Footer).

3. Implement dynamic WhatsApp link builder that pre-fills user plan selection (e.g., 'https://wa.me/919999999999?text=Hi%20myPaisaa,%20I%20am%20interested%20in%20the%20Rs%203%20Lakh%20Chit%20Plan%20with%20Rs%2012,000/mo%20savings').
4. Ensure full responsive design tested across 375px (iPhone), 768px (iPad) and 1440px desktop viewports.
5. Every button and input must include strict data-testid attributes for QA automation.
